value.rationale: The jump from 15 geometric planes on the classical Segre cubic to 27 on its characteristic-two special fiber is a natural, geometrically consequential special-fiber invariant, with twelve new geometric planes appearing in six quadratic Frobenius pairs. The cone is the unique maximally S6-symmetric F2 cubic surface and yields a nontrivial uniform zeta-count. This is not merely an arbitrary coefficient census or a restatement of the classical 27-line theorem; the Segre degeneration is the motivating link.
